"Create a 3D open-world survival adventure game.

The game takes place on a large tropical island with:

- A large open world to explore.
- Beautiful forests, mountains and beaches.
- Villages and abandoned buildings.
- Cars and motorcycles for transportation.
- Animals and wildlife.
- A character with health and energy.
- A day and night cycle.
- Weather changes and rain.
- Missions and hidden locations.
- Realistic 3D graphics.
- Third-person camera.
- Mobile touch controls.

Make the world explorable and playable. (3D Game, Desktop)

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
